title: 第2331章 师徒大战第2330章 封鬼大法
slug: 刚穿越就继承了宗主之位
lines: “这么多年了，真是一点长进都没有，为师的脸都要被你丢光了。”
“姜玄烨”淡淡地说道。
他依然坐在龙椅上，并没有起身，可见哪怕体内有了禁制，对自己的实力也是绝对的自信。
白帝稳了稳身形，黑剑上的幽光更盛。
“不过才热身而已。”
“您当年所教的招式，我还没有使用出来了。”
“今日，我就原封奉还。”
话音落下，白帝暴起，朝着龙椅上的“姜玄烨”再次挥剑而来。
白帝一剑刺出，剑尖所过之处，空间都被割裂出一道漆黑的裂缝。
“姜玄烨”神色一凝，终于动了。
他只是抬起一根手指，轻轻向前一点。
轰！
一道金色的指力自指尖炸开，与剑尖正面对撞。
“姜玄烨”虽然体内有禁制，但是他这一道指力依然非常恐怖，非常的霸道。
白帝的身躯被震退数十丈，脚踏虚空，瞬间稳住了身躯。
面对着“姜玄烨”恐怖的实力，他并没有感觉到意外，如果不是提前布局使他中了禁制，其胜算会更加的渺茫。
白帝眼神一凝，长剑横扫，剑气化作万千剑气，铺天盖地席卷而来。
“姜玄烨”看着这漫天剑气，冷哼一声：“早就跟你说过，攻其一面，不如攻其一点，这漫天剑气，看着攻击范围大，却是不如专修一剑，看来为师当年教导你的话，你并没有听进耳里。”
话音刚落，他从龙椅上站了起来。
仅仅是站起来，整个虚空便开始激烈的震荡，地面更是寸寸龟裂。
他缓缓伸出一只手臂，单手虚握，虚空中凭空凝练出一柄金色的长剑虚影，足足有百丈之上。
金色巨剑从天而降，与那漫天剑气正面交锋。
砰砰砰砰砰砰！！！！！！
轰轰轰轰轰轰！！！！！！
接连不断的爆炸在虚空中响起，如同两颗陨星撞击在一起。
爆炸产生的冲击波向着四面八方扩散，横扫一切。
那些无论是在暗中还是躲得远远的武修都受到了波及，不少人被震得口吐鲜血，只能再次后退。
如此恐怖的交锋，即便是冥渊不少凶兽也不敢靠近。
“嘶，这……这就是武帝的实力吗？”
“太强了，便是余波也能杀死我千百次！”
一个须发发白的老武修眼神中充满了震惊，与不可思议，他还是第一次看到武帝境的战斗，不要说他们激战了，光是余波就足以让他震惊了。
他声音颤抖地说道：“那位前辈刚刚破封，体内又有禁制压制他的实力，居然能与白帝打的不相上下，他的实力到底有多强大？”
顿了顿，他又叹道：“如果体内没有禁制，白帝怕不是他的对手，甚至都接不了几招。”
“值了，太值了，能看到这场战斗，老夫即便今日陨落，也是赚了。”
不少人在看到这场战斗之后，叹为观止。
这样的战斗，注定他们不能参与。
战场上。
白帝发动了第二波攻击。
content_en:
"After so many years, I really haven't made any progress at all. My teacher's face will be completely embarrassed by you."
"Jiang Xuanye" said lightly.
He was still sitting on the Dragon Throne and did not get up. This showed that even if there was a restriction in his body, he was absolutely confident in his own strength.
Bai Di stabilized his figure, and the dim light on the black sword became brighter.
"It's just a warm-up."
"I haven't used the moves you taught me back then."
"Today, I will return it intact."
As soon as the words fell, Bai Di stood up and swung his sword towards "Jiang Xuanye" on the dragon throne again.
Bai Di thrust out his sword, and wherever the sword tip passed, a dark crack was cut in the space.
"Jiang Xuanye" looked condensed and finally moved.
He just raised a finger and moved forward slightly.
boom!
A golden finger force exploded from the fingertips and collided head-on with the sword tip.
Although "Jiang Xuanye" has restrictions in his body, his finger power is still very terrifying and very domineering.
Bai Di's body was shaken back dozens of feet, his feet stepped on the void, and he stabilized his body instantly.
Facing the terrifying strength of "Jiang Xuanye", he didn't feel surprised. If he hadn't been banned by the advance plan, his chances of winning would have been even slimmer.
Bai Di's eyes condensed and he swept his long sword across. The sword energy turned into thousands of sword energy and swept over the sky and the earth.
"Jiang Xuanye" looked at the sword energy all over the sky and snorted coldly: "I told you a long time ago that it is better to attack one side than to attack one point. This sword energy all over the sky seems to have a large attack range, but it is not as good as specializing in one sword. It seems that you did not listen to what my master taught you back then."
As soon as he finished speaking, he stood up from the dragon chair.
Just by standing up, the entire void began to vibrate violently, and the ground became even more cracked.
He slowly stretched out an arm and held it empty with one hand, and a golden sword was condensed out of thin air, which was more than a hundred feet tall.
"Go!"
The golden giant sword fell from the sky and clashed head-on with the sword energy in the sky.
Bang bang bang bang bang bang! ! ! ! ! !
Boom boom boom boom boom! ! ! ! ! !
Continuous explosions sounded in the void, like two meteorites colliding together.
The shock wave generated by the explosion spread in all directions, sweeping everything.
Those martial cultivators who were either in the dark or hiding far away were all affected. Many of them were shocked to the point of vomiting blood and could only retreat again.
In such a terrifying confrontation, even many ferocious beasts in the underworld did not dare to approach.
"Hiss, this...is this the strength of Emperor Wu?"
"It's so strong, even the aftermath can kill me thousands of times!"
The eyes of an old martial artist with white hair and beard were full of shock and disbelief. This was the first time he saw a battle in the Martial Emperor Realm. Not to mention the fierce battle, the aftermath alone was enough to shock him.
He said with a trembling voice: "That senior has just broken the seal, and there are restrictions in his body that suppress his strength. He can actually fight on par with Bai Di. How strong is he?"
After a pause, he sighed again: "If there is no restriction in the body, Bai Di may not be his opponent, and he may not even be able to take a few moves."
"It's worth it, it's so worth it. I can see this battle. Even if I die today, I will still make a profit."
Many people were amazed after seeing this battle.
They are destined not to participate in such a battle.
On the battlefield.
Bai Di launched a second wave of attacks.
